name: group-intersection
description: Select objects at the intersection of blocks in group s1 and blocks in group s2 (in slot s3, or any slot). Selects the contacts or faces between two block groups, e.g. a tunnel surface before excavation.
notes: Live-checked on 3DEC 9.8.54 (2026-10-29): 'block contact group ... range group-intersection 'L' 'R'' takes the 1 contact and 'block contact group-subcontact' its 8 subcontacts between groups L and R; an unknown group selects nothing.
